subject: The secret feature 90% of users will miss
preview_text: This changes everything about how you predict matches. You're getting the first look before anyone else.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. We've been holding back. Not because we wanted to, but because we needed to get it right. And now it's almost ready.

Imagine this: you're watching a match, and you see a key player go down. Your gut says the game changes. Our new feature will tell you EXACTLY how much, in real-time, with data to back it up. It's not just predictions anymore—it's live tactical intelligence.

Next month, we're rolling out Live Match Impact Analysis. It watches the game with you, calculates how substitutions, injuries, and red cards shift the predicted outcome, and updates your insights instantly. You'll know the new most likely score before the free-kick is even taken.

Want to be the first to test it? Open the app now and tap the 'Coming Soon' banner on your home screen. We're selecting our most active users for the beta. P.S. The first 100 testers get their first month of Premium free if they provide feedback. Consider this your exclusive invitation.
